# Kooboo

> Kooboo is an AI-native web OS for building, running, and owning websites and business
> applications: AI website creation, visual editing, content management, databases,
> ecommerce, email, analytics, hosting, development and deployment in one portable system.
> This repository provides documentation indexes with topic summaries and links to
> docs.kooboo.com, plus the AI-facing skills and function definitions that power the Kooboo AI assistant.
> Product site: https://www.kooboo.com/ · Documentation site: https://docs.kooboo.com/

## Product documentation

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Docs/official-docs/README.md): 208 topics with titles, one-line summaries, and links to the full documentation at docs.kooboo.com.
- [KScript API reference](https://docs.kooboo.com/api/index.html): server-side `k.*` APIs for authentication, content, databases, commerce, payments, mail, files, networking and site resources.
- [Admin CMS guide](https://docs.kooboo.com/cms/index.html): site structure, content, commerce, database, development, settings and operations in the Kooboo console.
- [Template engine](https://docs.kooboo.com/templateEngine/index.html): `k-data`, bindings, layout, page, view, plus JS and CSS resource handling.
- [Quick start](https://docs.kooboo.com/quick-start/index.html): create a site, build a page, add content, add server-side logic, publish a domain.
- [中文文档索引](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Docs/official-docs/zh/README.md): 208 个主题的中文标题和摘要，链接到 docs.kooboo.com 的英文正文。

## AI skills (loaded by the Kooboo AI assistant)

- [Skills index](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/README.md): all 11 skill packages with their purposes.
- [browser-control](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/browser-control/SKILL.md): Browser control for the expanded right-side site preview, including observation, interaction, navigation, upload, and verification.
- [debug](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/debug/SKILL.md): Diagnose and fix problems in the current Kooboo site through an evidence-first workflow using Preview diagnostics, Network, Browser Control, source inspection, and Preflight. / Diagnose and fix blank pages, errors, netwo…
- [history](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/history/SKILL.md): Inspect Kooboo CMS history, list and filter change records, view object versions, compare revisions, undo selected changes, restore a website to a historical point, or check out a historical state as another website.
- [kooboo-ai-task-automation](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/kooboo-ai-task-automation/SKILL.md): Use when the user wants to create or refine a Kooboo AI Task Job, fixed routine, scheduled task, or chat-created automation from natural language, including write-capable jobs such as scheduled posting, content sync, cle…
- [kooboo-app-i18n](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/kooboo-app-i18n/SKILL.md): Add or maintain multilingual Vue AI Apps using Kooboo Labels and vue-i18n, including language switching, translated menus and titles, and component-library locales.
- [kooboo-cms-guide](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/kooboo-cms-guide/SKILL.md): Use when guiding users to Kooboo CMS admin URLs, show_action_button, get_site_info (siteId, baseUrl), or JWT/payment/SMS/OAuth setup links.
- [kooboo-coding](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/kooboo-coding/SKILL.md): Kooboo Site / App / Scoped Coding Router.
- [kooboo-jsonld](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/kooboo-jsonld/SKILL.md): Use when adding, inspecting, or debugging JSON-LD structured data in Kooboo pages, views, or layouts: k-json-ld, schema.org, Product, Article, Organization, BreadcrumbList, rich results, field mappings, or missing applic…
- [lighthouse-optimizer](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/lighthouse-optimizer/SKILL.md): Analyze Lighthouse or PageSpeed results for a Kooboo site, map failed audits and DOM/resource evidence to Pages, Views, Layouts, Scripts, Styles, Images, APIs, or CodeBlocks, produce prioritized optimization recommendati…
- [sandbox](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/sandbox/SKILL.md): Use a hidden Kooboo Sandbox site to copy selected site objects, make isolated changes, execute KData or KScript, render templates, and verify page output without changing the current site.
- [ui-ux-pro-max-pp](https://github.com/Kooboo/Kooboo/blob/main/Skills/ui-ux-pro-max-pp/SKILL.md): Use when Kooboo AI has entered site-building SOP S2/S3 and needs a Page Plan, Design System, or page View prompts.
